goatRearingHouseholds.label: Goat-rearing households
goatRearingHouseholds.unavailableReason: The NSS 77th round records goats together with sheep, pigs and rabbits as one 'ovine and other mammals' item, so goat-owning households cannot be separated. Its unit-level data also needs a free MoSPI login.

averageHerdSize.label: Average goat herd size
averageHerdSize.unavailableReason: Needs the number of goat-rearing households. The NSS 77th round records goats together with sheep, pigs and rabbits as one 'ovine and other mammals' item, so goat-owning households cannot be separated. Its unit-level data also needs a free MoSPI login.

perCapitaMeatConsumption.label: Per-capita goat meat consumption
perCapitaMeatConsumption.unavailableReason: HCES 2023-24 records 'goat meat/mutton' as one combined item (code 192, kg, last 7 days). No state-wise quantity table is published in the documents we could reach, and the unit-level data needs a free MoSPI login.

estimatedAnnualDemand.label: Estimated annual demand
estimatedAnnualDemand.unavailableReason: Needs state-wise per-capita consumption and goat meat production from the DAHD Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics, which we could not download.

goatMeatProduction.label: Goat meat production
goatMeatProduction.unavailableReason: Needs state-wise per-capita consumption and goat meat production from the DAHD Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics, which we could not download.

productionCoverage.label: Production coverage
productionCoverage.unavailableReason: Needs state-wise per-capita consumption and goat meat production from the DAHD Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics, which we could not download.

productionDemandBalance.label: Indicative surplus or deficit
productionDemandBalance.unavailableReason: Needs state-wise per-capita consumption and goat meat production from the DAHD Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics, which we could not download.
